glance.summary: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic adopt a shared policy token standard for publisher scraping opt-outs.
Google transmitted its first space-generated response using an on-board AI model on an orbiting satellite.
Worldwide Express automated freight billing exceptions using a multi-agent Amazon Bedrock solution, cutting exceptions 75 percent.
xAI faces a lawsuit over Clean Air Act violations after a judge allowed the case to proceed.

big_pour.headline: Tech giants join shared standard for web scraping opt-outs
big_pour.summary: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic will adopt a shared standard letting publishers set AI training preferences across multiple companies at once. The system uses a policy token signal.
big_pour.why: It gives website creators an easier way to control how AI models use their online content.

explain.kid: Big AI companies agreed on a new rule that lets people who make websites tell AI bots to stop copying their work.
explain.pm: Four major AI vendors are adopting a single policy token standard, simplifying scraping opt-outs for publishers across platforms.
explain.engineer: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic will support a shared policy token standard that lets publishers declare AI training opt-out preferences across multiple AI crawlers at once.

big_pour.headline: Google satellite AI model sends first response from space
big_pour.teaser: Google satellite AI responds from space
big_pour.summary: Google booted up Tensor Processing Units on an orbiting satellite to run its Gemma 4 model. The system generated its first response, creating a space haiku.

big_pour.headline: NAACP lawsuit against xAI data center proceeds
big_pour.summary: A judge allowed an NAACP lawsuit against xAI to move forward. The lawsuit accuses the SpaceX-owned company of violating the Clean Air Act at its data center.

office_blend.headline: Worldwide Express cuts freight billing exceptions with Amazon Bedrock
office_blend.summary: Worldwide Express built a multi-agent AI solution on Amazon Bedrock to automate freight billing exceptions. The system cut active exceptions by 75% and unlocked $10 million in free cash flow.

office_blend.headline: Epsilon automates user interface testing with Amazon Nova Act
office_blend.summary: Epsilon built a UI testing service using Amazon Nova Act and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser Tool. Tests written in plain English run on browsers managed by AWS with zero per-team infrastructure overhead.

still_roasting.summary: Pope Leo called for a ban on lethal autonomous weapons during an upcoming UN meeting in Geneva.
Google DeepMind unveiled its Genie 4 world model, which will roll out soon to developers and Google AI Ultra subscribers.
Apple announced it will launch Apple Intelligence in China starting with an iOS 27.3 beta on November 4th.

quick_sips.summary: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, will shut down in one week as the AI assistant market grows crowded.
Pay for AI-exposed IT jobs grew 46% since 2021, but tech workers face rising burnout and a widening gender gap.
Zest launched an AI agent that gathers dining preferences over text, votes on options, and books restaurant reservations.

stories.label: Open model
stories.headline: Mistral releases open weights for Mistral Large 4
stories.summary: Mistral released the weights for Mistral Large 4 on Hugging Face. The frontier open model holds a 1-point coding lead over GLM-5.3.

stories.label: Usage limits
stories.headline: Anthropic removes Claude Code five-hour rolling cap
stories.summary: Anthropic eliminated the rolling five-hour usage limit for Claude Code users on its $200 plan, provided their accounts stay in good standing.

concept.explanation: A pricing model where AI usage is billed per token. OpenAI considered dropping token-based pricing for its next model to charge per prompt instead, but backed off.

long_read.headline: The Pulse: Anthropic kills the coding interview
long_read.summary: The newsletter reports that Anthropic has removed Leetcode-style coding interviews from its hiring process because AI makes them pointless.

sign_off: That's the last sip. See you next morning.

word.definition: The code that coordinates models, tools, and steps in a workflow, deciding what runs, in what order, with what retries.
word.heard: "Keep the business logic in orchestration, not in the prompt."
word.analogy: Like the shift lead who decides who makes which drink and in what order.
